g.text: Two terminals on the same insulated foil electrode

g.desc: Two terminals on the same insulated foil electrode

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: J1 pins 1 and 2 land on the same foil electrode. Uno D2 drives the electrode through 1 Mohm; D4 samples the charging transition. Cover the foil with insulation and keep the lead short.

g.desc: J1 pins 1 and 2 land on the same foil electrode. Uno D2 drives the electrode through 1 Mohm; D4 samples the charging transition. Cover the foil with insulation and keep the lead short.

g.text: Leave the electrode floating: do not connect it to GND, mains wiring or an external supply. This is a rough timing demonstration, not a calibrated capacitive sensor. The optional 1 kohm series protection resistor near D4 is not shown.
